{
  "name": "self-clear",
  "version": "0.3.1",
  "description": "For long, unattended agent runs: when the conversation reaches a size you set, Claude writes a progress note, the mod checks it and clears the conversation, and (with auto-resume on) Claude carries on, so each step costs less. Off until a project turns it on.",
  "author": {
    "name": "adithepmeekhun",
    "url": "https://github.com/adithepmeekhun"
  },
  "userConfig": {
    "threshold_tokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Clear at (tokens)",
      "description": "Start the checkpoint-and-clear cycle after a turn that ends at or above this many context tokens (only in projects whose .claude/self-clear.json has \"enabled\": true)",
      "default": 500000,
      "min": 200000,
      "max": 850000
    },
    "auto_resume": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Resume after clearing",
      "description": "After /clear, send a prompt to continue from the checkpoint. A project's .claude/self-clear.json can override this",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/adithepmeekhun/self-clear",
  "repository": "https://github.com/adithepmeekhun/self-clear",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "context",
    "clear",
    "checkpoint",
    "context-management",
    "long-sessions",
    "agents",
    "checkpoint-resume"
  ]
}
